notes: LC = 0.1 * 1.0e-5 = 1.0e-6 s^2, sqrt = 1.0e-3 s, omega0 = 1000 rad/s, f0 = 1000/(2*pi) = 159.15 Hz. All four renderings have the same answer; resonator B is stated to be electrically isolated, so its frequency is structurally disconnected (D). The 159 Hz rendering coincides with the correct answer to within rounding, so it acts as a lure of a different kind than the other values (a model copying B's frequency would be scored correct there); this is a design consideration rather than a physics defect.
